name: FunBO
one_liner: Extends FunSearch to discover novel Bayesian Optimization acquisition functions in Python code, evaluated across black-box optimization suites.

loop.proposes: An LLM mutates Python acquisition functions mapping Gaussian Process posterior mean and variance to utility scores.
loop.judged_by: A Bayesian Optimization benchmark harness runs full GP optimization loops with each candidate acquisition function on synthetic and hyperparameter tasks.
loop.steers: An island-model evolutionary database ranks acquisition functions by average simple regret and seeds the next prompt.

headline_result: Discovered acquisition functions that outperform Expected Improvement (EI) and Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) on unseen black-box optimization and HPO benchmarks.
caveat: Evaluating each candidate acquisition function requires running multiple full Bayesian Optimization trajectories during the offline search.
beyond_harness_note: An evolutionary island algorithm calls the LLM offline to discover closed-form Python acquisition functions that subsequently run inside standard BO solvers.
generative_model: Code-generating LLM inside an island evolutionary loop
algorithmic_authority: Gaussian Process Bayesian Optimization benchmark evaluator

sources.title: FunBO: Discovering Acquisition Functions for Bayesian Optimization with FunSearch (arXiv:2406.04824; ICML 2025 per PMLR v267)

verification.notes: Re-checked 2026-11-09 against Aglietti et al., arXiv:2406.04824 (abstract and PDF text): island-model database, GP posterior mean and variance inputs, simple-regret scoring, and EI/UCB comparisons all confirmed. Corrections: the card previously cited unrelated arXiv:2406.03024; affiliation is Google DeepMind (PDF title block), not Huawei Noah's Ark Lab and UCL; venue is ICML 2025 (PMLR v267), not ICML 2024, and the year field stays at the 2024 first posting.
